name: bun
readme_excerpt: Bun: SQL-first Golang ORM Lightweight, SQL-first Golang ORM for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, SQLite, and Oracle Bun is a modern ORM that embraces SQL rather than hiding it.
